description: Licence register for toxic and radioactive production waste is a data set listed in data.gov.kg, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Natural Resources, Ecology and Technical Supervision of Kyrgyzstan. Coverage: Kyrgyzstan. Its title on the portal is "Реестр лицензий по отходам производства токсичных и радиоактивных материалов" (Russian). The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Natural Resources, Ecology and Technical Supervision of Kyrgyzstan. Its tags are источники ионизирующего излучения, отходы производства, радиоактивные материалы, реестр лицензий. It offers 9 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2025-03-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-kg-portal.
